clearance.method: fresh four_side_1024.l3d.world.World(model stack from the run layer_planes body heights, clearance=0.05); check_route(route, check_self=True) in route-id order, then add_route

crossings.crossing_rule: every flat part grouped by physical z (all heights, interface leads merged); fslw strict D56 audit per height; reused validate21.check_crossings

manual_frozen.rule: routes whose assignment row has a non-empty manual_group must keep the frozen E5 parts / length_mm / z fields byte-for-byte
